items.title: File Widerspruch against rejection of exception permit
items.quote: Gegen diesen Bescheid können Sie binnen eines Monats nach seiner Bekanntgabe Widerspruch einlegen.
items.computation: Letter dated Tuesday 02.12.2025, sent by ordinary post. Under § 41 Abs. 2 VwVfG (via Art. 41 Abs. 2 BayVwVfG), a letter sent by post within Germany is deemed delivered (Bekanntgabe) on the third day after posting, i.e. Friday 05.12.2025 (no evidence of later or non-receipt). Under § 187 Abs. 1 BGB the day of the triggering event (Bekanntgabe) is not counted, so the one-month period starts running on 06.12.2025. Under § 188 Abs. 2 BGB a period of months ending on an event-triggered start expires on the day of the last month whose number corresponds to the day the event fell on, i.e. 05.01.2026. 05.01.2026 is a Monday and not a Bavarian public holiday (Epiphany falls on 06.01), so no shift under § 193 BGB applies. Deadline: 05.01.2026.
